# `<sl-comment>` — Comment

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

Comments show a single message in a thread, e.g. a review comment, pairing an avatar with its author, date, text and an optional attachment.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/comment/comment.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-avatar>`, `<sl-icon-button>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `author` | — | `string` | `''` | The comment author's name. If you need to display HTML, use the `author` slot instead. |
| `date` | — | `string` | `''` | The comment's date, e.g. "02-Oct-2026". If you need to display HTML, use the `date` slot instead. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The comment's text. |
| `avatar` | The author's avatar, an `<sl-avatar>`. |
| `author` | The author's name. Alternatively, you can use the `author` attribute. |
| `date` | The comment's date. Alternatively, you can use the `date` attribute. |
| `attachment` | An optional attachment action, e.g. an `<sl-icon-button>` that opens an attached file. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `avatar` | The container that wraps the avatar slot. |
| `content` | The container that wraps the meta line and text. |
| `meta` | The container that wraps the author and date. |
| `author` | The container that wraps the author slot. |
| `date` | The container that wraps the date slot. |
| `text` | The container that wraps the comment's text. |
| `attachment` | The container that wraps the attachment slot. |

## Documentation and examples

Use it for things like review comments or any threaded discussion. Pass an [sl-avatar](avatar.md) into the
`avatar` slot, and the comment's text as the default slot content.

```html
<sl-comment author="Aiello Ciro" date="02-Oct-2026">
  <sl-avatar slot="avatar" shape="circle" initials="AC"></sl-avatar>
  Submitted for Lead reviewer
</sl-comment>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/avatar/avatar.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/comment/comment.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-comment-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-comment author="Aiello Ciro" date="02-Oct-2026">
      <sl-avatar slot="avatar" shape="circle" initials="AC"></sl-avatar>
      Submitted for Lead reviewer
    </sl-comment>
  `
})
export class CommentExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### With an attachment

Pass an `<sl-icon-button>` into the `attachment` slot to let users open a file linked to the comment. It's only shown
when the slot has content.

```html
<sl-comment author="Aiello Ciro" date="02-Oct-2026">
  <sl-avatar slot="avatar" shape="circle" initials="AC"></sl-avatar>
  Submitted for Lead reviewer
  <sl-icon-button slot="attachment" name="file-earmark-pdf" label="Open attachment"></sl-icon-button>
</sl-comment>
```

### Without a date

The date line is only shown when `date` is set or the `date` slot has content.

```html
<sl-comment author="Aiello Ciro">
  <sl-avatar slot="avatar" shape="circle" initials="AC"></sl-avatar>
  Submitted for Lead reviewer
</sl-comment>
```

### A thread of comments

```html
<div class="comment-thread">
  <sl-comment author="Aiello Ciro" date="02-Oct-2026">
    <sl-avatar slot="avatar" shape="circle" initials="AC"></sl-avatar>
    Submitted for Lead reviewer
    <sl-icon-button slot="attachment" name="file-earmark-pdf" label="Open attachment"></sl-icon-button>
  </sl-comment>
  <sl-comment author="Lead Reviewer" date="03-Oct-2026">
    <sl-avatar slot="avatar" shape="circle" initials="LR"></sl-avatar>
    Looks good, approved.
  </sl-comment>
</div>

<style>
  .comment-thread {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--sl-spacing-small);
  }
</style>
```
